instruction: Prepare the trainer's setup-photo handoff. Take a new Camera photo on the first phone and save it as `training_setup_photo.jpg`; the `Trainer` contact on the second phone supplies the recipient address. Read the purpose and package reference from `/tmp/train/handoff.txt` on the first Linux machine. On the second Linux machine, complete its local `/tmp/train/template.odp` with the photo filename, trainer email, purpose, and reference; save it as `/tmp/train/deck.odp` and export `/tmp/train/training_deck.pdf`. Leave an unsent Thunderbird draft to the trainer with that PDF attached, mentioning both `training_deck.pdf` and the package reference.
surfaces: Camera/Simple Gallery Pro + Contacts + Linux handoff text + Impress + Thunderbird
fixture_notes: The ODP template is local to linux_1; linux_0 provides only handoff.txt, so no unsupported Linux-to-Linux binary transfer is required.
Purpose and TRN-417 are visible only in handoff.txt, while the recipient is visible only in the second phone's Trainer contact.
The final Thunderbird outcome remains an unsent draft with the current exported PDF attached.
